verdict.rationale: Hands-on community reports say Ghostty handles heavy output well: catting a large file 'performs very well... among the same league as Alacritty and Ptyxis,' and another user calls it a 'modern high performance terminal.' First-party docs only say libghostty provides rendering and that synchronized rendering is supported; none of the evidence documents GPU acceleration. Some users also report noticeable input latency (around 13ms, called 'acceptable') and higher latency than xfce4-terminal, which tempers the responsiveness half of the story. missing for 10: first-party documentation of GPU-accelerated rendering (e.g. Metal/OpenGL renderer), published throughput/latency benchmarks, consistent independent evidence of low input latency.
